scope_statement: PASS applies to the implemented offline V4 FSM, authenticated transport boundary, role-process mount isolation, memory/checkpoint recovery and zero-human-relay fixture. It is not NORTHSTAR_E2E_PASS: V4 replays pinned Hermes outputs, performs no new inference and does not verify two real models.

criteria.evidence: Read-only uws_v4.db inspection found exactly 15 events, 15 unique event IDs, 15 unique idempotency keys, valid payload hashes and the required rejection -> rework -> QA_PASS -> MORCH_REVIEW -> ACCEPTED -> TERMINAL_COMPLETED sequence.

Each send and consume is initiated by a new actor-specific bwrap client. Each client receives only /identity/key.bin for its actor plus the Unix socket; UWS reconciliation is initiated by a separate UWS bwrap client. The daemon executes ledger mutations and validates the actor capability before accepting the operation.

Current supervisor_v2.py has no SecureTransport import or call. It does not read key bytes; it selects one key path for a bwrap mount and invokes the RPC client. SecureTransport and transport_v4.db are owned by the ephemeral transport_rpc daemon.

Independent QA-context mount probe observed exactly one identity file named key.bin, size 32 bytes; no MORCH key, state directory or transport DB was visible. The same actor_rpc construction is used for MORCH, RORCH, QA and UWS.

QA role execution receives RORCH app read-only and QA evidence writable, with no state mount. Runtime permission evidence records app write denial and missing state path. Independent mount probe confirmed state_visible=false, transport_db_visible=false and other_key_visible=false.

Current transport_rpc authenticates the supplied HMAC capability before privileged-role authorization. Independent ephemeral RPC probe verified QA key presented as MORCH => actor capability mismatch, while authenticated QA requesting UWS snapshot => operation requires UWS. evidence/identity_boundary_probe.json records the same two fail-closed outcomes.

transport_v4.db has 7 unique messages/nonces, 7 outbox ACKED, 7 inbox ACKED and 32 append-only audit rows. Independent recomputation verified all producer signatures, consumer receipts, payload hashes and audit hashes. Each message has attempt_count=1.

Independent read-only bwrap suite passed 29/29 tests. Transport cases include replay/stale timestamp, role/route escalation, spoofed QA, forged QA_PASS, wrong consumer, concurrent single-winner claim, duplicate/conflict, retry/dead-letter, lease recovery, ambiguous ACK reopen and append-only audit. A separate ephemeral RPC flow passed valid send/consume/reconcile and rejected three focalized identity/role attacks.

supervisor_v2 starts one transport_rpc serve process for transport_v4.db, waits for its Unix socket and capabilities, uses only RPC during the run, requests UWS-authenticated shutdown in finally, and waits for daemon exit. No transport daemon remained after evidence collection.

memory_v4.db has 10 hash-chained records, 3 checkpoints, a consumed MORCH_LOCAL_ADAPTER activation and a valid independently recomputed chain. Phase evidence shows controlled interruption at QA_REJECTED and later terminal recovery without duplicate events/messages.

QA_PASS v4-qa-pass durably produced one consumed MORCH_ACTIVATION; the subsequent decision is authored as MORCH_LOCAL_ADAPTER. This is a local durable coordinator, not ChatGPT or a remote always-on listener.

After supervisor launch, the fixture transports all seven handoffs and completes rejection, repair, re-review, MORCH acceptance and RORCH acknowledgement without manual message relay. Durable memory/result evidence records human_relay_count=0.
V4 accurately labels its seven model-derived inputs PINNED_REAL_HERMES_BASELINE_REPLAY and pins their SHA256 values. The fixture does not misclassify replay as new inference.
V4 makes no provider call; it replays previously captured Hermes result artifacts.

Offline router tests cover two synthetic backends and fallback, but no second authenticated real model/provider was executed. This remains outside the V4 functional PASS and prevents NORTHSTAR_E2E_PASS.

limitations: NTV_FUNCTIONAL PASS does not cover NTV_ROOT, Windows ACL effectiveness, key-file host permissions, rollback, post-close drift or writes by unrelated host processes.

Actor clients initiate authenticated send/consume operations; the daemon validates capabilities and performs the durable SQLite mutation. This is a brokered ACK design, not direct actor access to the ledger.

The consume RPC returns message identity/type and payload digest, while fixture work products are supplied through separately mounted pinned artifacts. Production payload-dispatch integration remains outside this fixture.
Pinned replay and absent real multimodel execution mean the overall mission remains NORTHSTAR_PARTIAL even though the implemented V4 functional slice passes.
